title: Cryptography — Advanced Theory and Engineering
tagline: Go beyond the fundamentals into security proofs, advanced constructions, cryptanalysis, privacy-preserving computation, side channels, and production cryptographic architecture.
summary: An advanced continuation of Cryptography Fundamentals. It explores provable-security models, multi-user bounds, AEAD internals, commitments, zero-knowledge proofs, MPC, homomorphic and searchable encryption, threshold cryptography, differential privacy, post-quantum migration, cryptanalysis, formal verification, protocol analysis, and end-to-end architecture reviews.
